blurb: 360 Yoga Charleston is a locally owned community studio dedicated to authentic yoga practice with classes including Original Hot Yoga (26&2), Hot Yoga Flow, Hot Pilates, Yin Stretch & Relax, and special events. The studio maintains a positive, challenging, and rewarding environment with fully equipped locker rooms and showers. Classes are 60, 75, or 90 minutes long and the studio is kept at approximately 105° F and 40% humidity.
